project.title: Phylogenetic relationships of Aigeiros Duby and Tacamahaca Spach poplars (genus Populus L., Salicaceae) based on the sex-determining region and traditionally used nuclear and chloroplast sequences
project.description: Phylogenetic relationships of 379 poplars from sections Aigeiros Duby and Tacamahaca Spach (genus Populus L., Salicaceae) were determined based on Illumina targeted deep sequencing of loci corresponding to the sex-determining region and traditionally used nuclear (NTS 5S rDNA, ITS, DSH 2, DSH 5, DSH 8, DSH 12, DSH 29, 6, 15, 16, X18) and chloroplast (trnG-psbK-psbI, rps2-rpoC2, rpoC2-rpoC1) sequences.
project.center_name: Engelhardt Institute of Molecular Biology, Russian Academy of Sciences
